title: Personnel of R.D.'s first band and Alphonse Gambler
summary: The first band had about six players including Charlie Bruden; Ida remembers trumpeter Alphonse Gambler.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in that first band he played with?

I was. When you first saw that, I was the R.D., myself. And now who were the other boys? Charlie Bruden. And I don't know. I can't remember everybody with that, but I do remember Charlie Bruden and R.D. He started out.
How many people in the band?
Oh, it was around about six of us.
And R.D. played trumpet with you.

Well, he came in, true enough, but what I mean, he's just talking about when he started off. Oh, he started off. Oh, he started off. Alphonse was with him when we first started off. Who was Alphonse? Alphonse Gambler. He's a trumpet player. He worked with all of us, too. Alphonse Gambler? Gambler. Gambler. G.M.B.L.E. Gambler. He's a fine trumpet player, but he doesn't play anymore. He had always teeth pulled, so he doesn't play anymore. That was Diddy Buddy. He works at the post-op. He's something at the post-op now.
